title: Permissive WebView capability enabled via webView.settings.javaScriptEnabled = true (kotlin) — review required
description: The kotlin setting webView.settings.javaScriptEnabled = true widens what a WebView may do with loaded content: script execution, file access or universal access from file URLs. Combined with any navigable content these grants reach local files and native interfaces. Keep the setting disabled, or scope it to bundled assets (JavaScript disabled for navigable content). This lexical rule flags the grant.
remediation: Remove webView.settings.javaScriptEnabled = true; keep the capability disabled or restrict it to bundled, non-attacker-controlled assets (JavaScript disabled for navigable content).
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the grant; whether the WebView ever loads untrusted content is reviewed separately.
